lcdm_amplitude_significance.why_withheld: the naive chi^2 uses the linear cosmic-variance LOWER BOUND, so its large apparent significance (~9 sigma) is an artifact, NOT a cosmological anomaly; a credible amplitude significance needs the minimum-variance ideal-window estimator (isolates the large-scale flow) or release-matched mocks (full nonlinear + selection covariance), which stay BLOCKED_MISSING_RELEASE_MOCK_OWNERSHIP

linear_cosmic_variance_lower_bound.method: estimator-matched mode-function window integral (linear theory); replaces the frozen card's scalar 150 km/s isotropic prior
linear_cosmic_variance_lower_bound.why_lower_bound: the noise-weighted GLS estimator aliases small-scale (nonlinear) velocity power that linear theory omits, so the linear window cosmic variance underestimates the true LambdaCDM scatter of this estimator

scope_not_claimed: a model-independent kinematic MEASUREMENT (|B|, apex, Omega_tilt); NO LambdaCDM tension/anomaly claim (significance withheld), and NOT a Bianchi family, geometry, or observer-frame-violation claim; the theory-g tilt link is out of scope (it needs the native low-multipole solver)
